rv.q: Now for the bad news about Thea Sharrock’s production.
This may be the last time The Bodyguard graces the West End stage and for fans of Whitney Houston and for theatre aficionados, this is most definitely worth a re-visit.
Beverley Knight who plays our leading lady Rachel Marron, is phenomenal.
The Bodyguard is a glitzy, energetic night out with at least two unmissable performances.
